main_text.head: Exercitatio XIX.

head.i: Narratio belli Siculi ab Athenienfibus ad Syracusas infeliciter gesti ex Thucydidis l.6.& 7.

main_text.p: Observentur leges bonæ narrationis, nec insistatur orationibus aut circunstantiis non necessariis.

I. EXponatur ἀφορμὴ belli Siculi: quæ fuit Legestanorum legatio ad Athenienses de impetrandis auxiliis contra Selinuntios & Syracusanos: & legatorum oratio, quod Syracusani, nisi reprimerentur, Siciliam viderentur in suam redacturi potestatem, posteaque junctis armis cum Peleponensibus imperium Athenienfium eversuri.

page.notes: Greek words ἀφορμὴ and πάθος-like marks in the first lines are read approximately; "πάθος" in "Addatur" line is a Greek mark read with [?] advised: πάθος[?]. The chapter number "XIX" was printed "XIX" in the heading. Printed "II." and "III." etc. are Roman numerals of the section list, kept as printed.
